proposals.relationship: Huang Kewu compares Liang’s plural account of historical causation with Weber’s rejection of a single controlling historical factor.
proposals.evidence_note: Huang2003 printed196, visually collated, places Liang’s explicit refusal of a sole explanatory principle alongside Weber’s complex, multiple historical causes, contrasting both with Marxist historical materialism. This is Huang’s undirected scholarly comparison. It does not establish Liang read Weber, shared every Weberian position, or derived the conception solely from a European thinker; Huang emphasizes Buddhist and Confucian resources. Note65 cites Liang’s 非唯 in Yinbingshi Wenji41p82; no particular Weber edition is cited in this checked sentence and none is invented. Liang’s original essay and Weber’s works unread; quoted Chinese checked in the mediating paper.
